plan.description: Load the single-cell dataset and perform initial quality control and normalization using Scanpy. This step will filter low-quality cells and genes, normalize the gene expression, and log-transform the data to prepare for downstream analysis.
input_filename: /cs/student/projects2/aisd/2024/shekchu/projects/cell_agents/remove_label/dataset_restricted_with_cluster.h5ad: A unannotated single-cell RNA-seq breast cancer dataset containing gene expression profiles with cell barcodes, gene names, and cell clustering information.

plan.description: Perform clustering analysis on the preprocessed data to group cells based on their gene expression profiles. This step will use unsupervised clustering algorithms available within Scanpy to re-examine or refine the existing clustering and facilitate downstream marker detection.
output_filename: ./output/o3_with_cluster/clustered_dataset.h5ad: clustered single-cell dataset with cell clusters annotated

plan.description: Identify marker genes for each cluster with emphasis on potential cancer-associated (malignant) markers. This step employs a marker gene identification tool to detect differentially expressed genes between clusters. The resulting list of marker genes will aid in differentiating malignant from non-malignant cells.
input_filename: ./output/o3_with_cluster/clustered_dataset.h5ad: clustered single-cell dataset with cell clusters annotated
output_filename: ./output/o3_with_cluster/marker_genes.txt: list of marker genes per cluster with emphasis on malignant markers

plan.description: Classify each cell as malignant or non-malignant by leveraging the marker genes identified in the previous step. This will involve evaluating the expression of top marker genes and known cancer-associated signatures using a comprehensive analysis pipeline tailored for single-cell classification.
input_filename: ./output/o3_with_cluster/clustered_dataset.h5ad: clustered single-cell dataset with cell clusters annotated
./output/o3_with_cluster/marker_genes.txt: list of marker genes per cluster with emphasis on malignant markers
output_filename: ./output/o3_with_cluster/classified_cells.txt: text file with cell barcodes and their classification as malignant or non-malignant
plan.tools: Single cell full-process analysis with top marker genes

plan.description: Integrate the cell classification labels into the original single-cell dataset and generate an annotated h5ad file. This final step consolidates the classification results with existing gene expression and clustering information for downstream biological interpretation.
input_filename: ./output/o3_with_cluster/clustered_dataset.h5ad: clustered single-cell dataset with cell clusters annotated
./output/o3_with_cluster/classified_cells.txt: text file with cell barcodes and their classification
output_filename: ./output/o3_with_cluster/cell_classification.h5ad: annotated h5ad file with cell malignancy classification
